content: पांसु(शु)ल {%a.%} [पांसुरस्त्यस्य सिध्मा˚ लच्] .²1 Dusty, covered with dust; परिपाण्डु पांसुलकपोलमाननम् <ls>Māl. 2. 4</ls>. .²2 Polluted, defiled, sullied, stained; दारत्यागी भवाम्याहो परस्त्रीस्पर्शपांशुलः <ls>Ś. 5. 29</ls>. .²3 Defiling, disgracing, dishonouring; as in कुलपांसुल. .{@-लः@} .²1 A profligate or licentious person, libertine, gallant. .²2 One of the weapons of Śiva. .²3 An epithet of Śiva. .{@-लः, -लम्@} A dusty place. .{@-ला@} .²1 A menstruous woman. .²2 An unchaste or licentious woman; अ˚ a chaste woman, अपांसुलानां धुरि कीर्तनीया <ls>R. 2. 2</ls>. .²3 The earth.
